Enum Class CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer>
org.wpilib.hardware.hal.CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer>, Constable
Enclosing class:
CANAPITypes
public static enum CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer extends Enum<CANAPITypes.CANManufacturer>
FIRST CAN manufacturer ID.

This enum represents different manufacturer IDs for CAN devices. Teams are encouraged to use the TEAM_USE manufacturer ID for custom or team-specific devices.

See Also:
